dict.string: Perch Tap sends the keyboard shortcut or media key a knock is mapped to.
Perch Tap asks System Events to type the shortcut a knock is mapped to, and runs your AppleScript actions.

Perch Tap can notice typing so knocks are ignored while you type. Optional — Accessibility already covers this.
Perch Tap reads the MacBook's built-in motion sensor to feel knocks on the chassis.
